description:
Summary:
the previous PR introduces an unit test that will fail and thus break the truck.

The reason is that the to() op implemented in previous diff will cause to_dense() and dispatch to original to() method. The to_dense() currently does not support int8 so the test on dtype int8 will fail.

We can simply remove int8 in unit test to fix the truck.

Fixed indentation error on `dtypes` decorator for `test_semi_sparse_to_device_cuda` (3 spaces → 4 spaces). Applied pyfmt formatting.
